dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: Yup! This is my first time outside Mondstadt. Everything here is so cool!

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: When I was small, I could only read "Vera's Melancholy." I would imagine I was Vera, experiencing all kinds of amazing adventures!

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: I know! I'll give you this copy of "Vera's Melancholy." I might have flipped through it a bit too much...

dialogues.speaker: Tia
dialogues.text: But I don't need it anymore, because I'm on a real adventure with Daddy. My experiences will be even more interesting than the novel!
